annotations.title: Remove rows of a declared format

description: Remove rows from a declared format by id — **a list of them in one call**. **Refused while any other row still links to one of them** — the dry run names those rows; re-link or clear them first. The app removes one row at a time from `#/formats/<name>`; this is how thirty go at once, after printing every one of them in full. Writes nothing until `commit: true`; a copy of the document is taken first, and it is the only way back.

commit.description: Remove them. Omit or false for the dry run.

ids.description: Row ids, as `format_rows` printed them. Up to 200.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

name: delete_format_rows
